usedFor: Helpwise is a shared inbox, where “Add Note” logs context and “Assign Conversation” hands a thread to a user.

bestTemplate.name: “Assign Conversation” in Helpwise
bestTemplate.why: It hands a conversation to a chosen user, so nothing sits in the shared inbox without an owner.

watchOut: “Assign Conversation” in Helpwise needs a user to assign to, so an earlier step must pass one.
